## usnm BOINC
The BOINC server app and its jobs (bridge, gold bundle, app version publish, init, secrets), from the platform's events in `ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL` and the containers' output in `ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL` in this workspace. Times are UTC; the workspace keeps 30 days.

The BOINC daemons (feeder, transitioner, validators, assimilator, file deleter) are started by `bin/start` and write to log files on the project share, not to stdout, so their lines are not here. Work volume (results in progress, users, hosts) is on the project's [server status page](https://boinc.usnewsmap.com/server_status.php).

content.query:
let sys = ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL
    | extend App = coalesce(column_ifexists("ContainerAppName_s", ""), column_ifexists("ContainerJobName_s", "")),
        Revision = column_ifexists("RevisionName_s", ""),
        Replica = column_ifexists("ReplicaName_s", ""),
        Execution = column_ifexists("ExecutionName_s", ""),
        Reason = column_ifexists("Reason_s", ""),
        Kind = column_ifexists("Type_s", ""),
        Msg = column_ifexists("Log_s", "")
    | where App startswith "usnm-boinc";
sys
| where App has "-caj-" and isnotempty(Execution)
| summarize Started = min(TimeGenerated), Warnings = countif(Kind == "Warning"), arg_max(TimeGenerated, Reason) by Job = App, Execution
| project Job, Execution, Started, Last = TimeGenerated, Status = Reason, Warnings
| order by Started desc
content.title: Job executions

content.query:
let sys = ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL
    | extend App = coalesce(column_ifexists("ContainerAppName_s", ""), column_ifexists("ContainerJobName_s", "")),
        Revision = column_ifexists("RevisionName_s", ""),
        Replica = column_ifexists("ReplicaName_s", ""),
        Execution = column_ifexists("ExecutionName_s", ""),
        Reason = column_ifexists("Reason_s", ""),
        Kind = column_ifexists("Type_s", ""),
        Msg = column_ifexists("Log_s", "")
    | where App startswith "usnm-boinc";
sys
| where App has "-caj-" and isnotempty(Execution)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Reason) by App, Execution
| summarize Executions = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), Status = Reason
content.title: Job executions per day, by last event

content.query:
let sys = ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL
    | extend App = coalesce(column_ifexists("ContainerAppName_s", ""), column_ifexists("ContainerJobName_s", "")),
        Revision = column_ifexists("RevisionName_s", ""),
        Replica = column_ifexists("ReplicaName_s", ""),
        Execution = column_ifexists("ExecutionName_s", ""),
        Reason = column_ifexists("Reason_s", ""),
        Kind = column_ifexists("Type_s", ""),
        Msg = column_ifexists("Log_s", "")
    | where App startswith "usnm-boinc";
sys
| where App has "-ca-" and isnotempty(Revision)
| summarize First = min(TimeGenerated), Last = max(TimeGenerated), Replicas = dcount(Replica), Warnings = countif(Kind == "Warning") by Revision
| order by First desc
content.title: Server app revisions

content.query:
let sys = ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL
    | extend App = coalesce(column_ifexists("ContainerAppName_s", ""), column_ifexists("ContainerJobName_s", "")),
        Revision = column_ifexists("RevisionName_s", ""),
        Replica = column_ifexists("ReplicaName_s", ""),

| summarize Events = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), Reason
content.title: Server app warnings (restarts, probe failures, crashes) per hour

content.query:
let sys = ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL
    | extend App = coalesce(column_ifexists("ContainerAppName_s", ""), column_ifexists("ContainerJobName_s", "")),
        Revision = column_ifexists("RevisionName_s", ""),
        Replica = column_ifexists("ReplicaName_s", ""),
        Execution = column_ifexists("ExecutionName_s", ""),
        Reason = column_ifexists("Reason_s", ""),
        Kind = column_ifexists("Type_s", ""),
        Msg = column_ifexists("Log_s", "")
    | where App startswith "usnm-boinc";
sys
| where Kind == "Warning"
| project TimeGenerated, App, Revision, Execution, Reason, Msg
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Latest platform warnings

content.query:
ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| extend App = coalesce(column_ifexists("ContainerAppName_s", ""), column_ifexists("ContainerJobName_s", "")),
    Msg = column_ifexists("Log_s", "")
| where App startswith "usnm-boinc"
| where Msg has_any ("error", "fail", "usnm-boinc:")
| where Msg !has "IDENTITY_HEADER" and Msg !has "MSI_SECRET"
| project TimeGenerated, App, Msg
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 200
content.title: Job and app errors in console output
